t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are pairs of gnomes that come paired by colours. in those pairs of colours there is a choice that yeilds the best mushrooms and thus more bonus.It seems like the primary colours red, pink green and blue are the best for mushroom points. look for the best colour rewards and quickly pick those ones

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes are paired by colours, each colour matching a different value of mushrooms.The goal is to get the most mushrooms by consistently picking the one that will yield the most value.It seems like the pink, red, green and blue ones give the most points consistently.I think picking these options the most times will give you the best outcome
